title: Two-Storey House With Stair
summary: M3 executable fixture for cross-level residential authoring: two levels, raw-bundle stair, raw-bundle stair opening, raw-bundle railing, hosted openings, plan/section evidence hooks, and drawing-sheet output.

ui.claim: UI/Cmd+K affordances are mapped to the fixture, but no browser-authored exact-input run is claimed.

cmdK.claim: Cmd+K coverage is classified conservatively: stair, shaft/opening, railing, floor, wall, and room steps are mostly tool activators, while hosted opening actions are contextual commits with missing exact fixture parameters.

mcpCli.claim: The deterministic fixture is executable offline and can post the bundle to /bundles in live dry-run mode when a target model is supplied. Stair, slab opening, and railing remain raw bundle payloads, not typed MCP parity.

advisor.claim: Advisor validation hooks are declared for live targets, including stair penetration, guardrail, and headroom checks, but no committed advisor artifact is present.

visual.claim: Required plan, upper plan, stair section, 3D, and sheet raster hooks are declared; no visual artifact is collected.

export.claim: IFC/glTF/PDF export hook contracts are declared; no export artifact is collected.

remainingBlockers: Stair, stair-opening, and railing fixture steps are raw bundle commands rather than first-class typed MCP/CLI tools.
No browser-authored UI/Cmd+K run creates the exact fixture dimensions and produces an independent model snapshot.
No committed live target evidence has been collected for advisor, visual, or export hooks.
